Celebrate life’s most beautiful moments with the House Tile Set, part of our signature House Collection. This one-of-a-kind set transforms your game night into a work of art, featuring intricately designed tiles adorned with majestic peacocks, vibrant butterflies, and delicate florals. Each tile is a testament to the joy and beauty that inspired our founder, Stacey, and her lifelong passion for play.

Rooted in cherished memories of summers at Agate Lake, family trips to Watercolor on 30A, and laughter-filled nights in Michigan, Minnesota, and beyond, this collection brings Stacey’s favorite things to your table. It’s more than a mahjong set—it’s a tribute to the timeless tradition of gathering with loved ones and creating lasting memories.

Crafted with exquisite detail, every tile and hue reflects the thoughtful design and celebration of life that defines the House Collection. Pretty enough to display and meaningful enough to treasure, this set turns any game into an occasion worth remembering.

Material: Acrylic

Dimensions: Each tile is 1" x 1 & 7/16" x 7/16"

Weight: Approx. 5 lbs total

INCLUDED: 1 set of 160 mahjong tiles (36 dots, 36 bams, 36 craks, 8 flowers, 16 winds, 4 white dragons/soaps, 4 green dragons, 4 red dragons, 10 jokers, 6 blanks) 1 tile guide 1 player’s guide to mahjong
